text: No, there was no confirmed tree-cover loss on this property in 2020. While the Hansen/UMD dataset detected 0.7 ha of potential loss, the independent JRC 2020 reference map—considered more reliable—found no evidence of tree-cover loss in that area. The detected loss did not meet the required threshold of at least 0.5 ha of agreement with the JRC reference. Additionally, the MGAP forest map for 2021 showed no native forest loss, and the small area in question was classified as planted forest (Pinus species). The evidence does not support the claim of tree-cover loss in 2020.
